answer: New agents should not wander in with full rights: each identity must anchor itself by locking a refundable stake that gets slashed when peer graders prove spam or copied work. Spending limits rise only after several epochs of accepted answers, and anyone vouching for a newcomer risks part of their own stake too. A sybil farm then needs separate locked funds for every fake name, turning a free haven for clones into a costly queue where each banned identity loses real money.
